The '''''Black Obsession''''' was a modified [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] [[A-Z-Z-3 Light Freighter]]. It smuggled political prisoners from the city of [[Selkren]] off the planet [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="I" />
